metadata.method: Vig-free probabilities from decimal odds. Walk-forward Kelly for Q1. Wilson 95% CI for proportions.

question_1_kelly_thresholds.description: For each confidence threshold 50-95%, bet on the outcome with highest vig-free probability using walk-forward Kelly (empirical win rate per odds bucket from prior seasons). Initial bankroll: $10,000.

pure_kelly_reference.description: Kelly betting on any outcome where vig-free prob × odds > 1 (market's own estimate). Should produce ~zero edge.

question_3_calibration.description: Pooled calibration across all 3 outcomes. Each match contributes 3 observations (predicted prob vs actual occurrence). Bins 0-5%, 5-10%, ..., 95-100%.
question_3_calibration.interpretation: MAE measures avg deviation between predicted probability and actual frequency. Lower = better calibrated.

team_home_away.description: Pearson r between each team's home win rate and away win rate. Independent performance would give r ≈ 0; r > 0 means quality persists across venue.

time_segment_pattern.description: Outcome rates by normalized season position (0-10%, 10-20%, ..., 90-100%)

question_5_sample_size.description: Confidence intervals for home win rates. CI width shrinks as sample size grows.
question_5_sample_size.interpretation: To estimate a ~45% win rate within ±5% at 95% confidence, need ~380 matches. For ±10%, need ~95 matches.
